newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton market closed for Moslem festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton market closed for Moslem festival.

text.p: The Bombay cotton market was closed on Monday for a Moslem festival.
On Friday, cotton prices dropped on improved new crop arrivals and sluggish buying from cotton mills.
In spot, Bengal-deshi fell five rupees to 775/820 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and F-414 suffered a similar loss at 1,810/1,830 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell 100 rupees to 11,400/11,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
